high_level_description: The image features a person standing against a plain, light pink wall. The individual is wearing a sleeveless black dress that fits closely to the body, accentuating their figure. They have long, straight hair that falls over their shoulders. Accessorized with a gold necklace featuring a heart-shaped pendant, they also wear a pair of large, dark sunglasses that cover most of their eyes. The person has one hand resting on their chest, while the other hangs by their side. A small, black shoulder bag with a chain strap is slung over their left shoulder.
